description: Defines the PyHandleCache class, which manages a cache of Python object pointers associated with C++ objects, using atomic operations for thread safety and interpreter context management.

classes.name: PyHandleCache
classes.description: A cache class for managing Python object pointers associated with C++ objects, ensuring thread safety and interpreter context consistency.

methods.name: ptr_or
